stories.title: US death row inmate Christa Pike awake and speaking after failed execution, lawyers say
stories.body: Experts say her survival after the lethal injections is highly unusual.

stories.title: Tear gas in Paris and Marseille as school protests grow across France
stories.body: Crowds of mainly teenagers called for more resources for schools and an end to what they called police repression.

stories.title: Former German spy chief arrested for espionage and treason
stories.body: August Hanning is accused of obtaining classified information for a foreign power.

stories.title: A beautiful Himalayan bird is changing its voice due to human activity, research shows
stories.body: A sharp increase in human activity is affecting the way the Himalayan monal lives and communicates, studies show.

stories.title: Lawyer for one of Cornell 7 calls for special prosecutor to be removed over previous comments
stories.body: New York Attorney General Letitia James is investigating the rape allegations, but the lawyer says comments she made on the case should disqualify her.

stories.title: Finland orders halt to work on two Google data centres
stories.body: The order affecting two planned data centres follows concerns over forest clearance.

stories.title: Kenya confirms its first Ebola death as outbreak spreads
stories.body: The patient had been living in DR Congo, where more than 4,000 people have died from the disease this year.

stories.title: AfD candidate elected speaker of German regional parliament for first time
stories.body: Although Tobias Rausch's role is largely symbolic, opponents have described the result as a watershed moment.

stories.title: 'Ghost particles' from space telescope wins physics Nobel
stories.body: Belgian physicist Prof Francis Halzen has won for his pioneering work on an observatory that detects particles from space.

stories.title: Ship sinks and crew missing after Black Sea drone attack
stories.body: It is not clear who is behind the attacks which come as Russia intensifies strikes in the Black Sea as part of its war against Ukraine.

stories.title: Indian opposition MPs detained in protest against election chief
stories.body: Opposition leaders have alleged that CEC Gyanesh Kumar manipulated voter rolls to favour Prime Minister Narendra Modi's party during elections.

stories.title: White House defends Trump comment to let Iran 'take out' LA and San Diego
stories.body: Gavin Newsom called the remarks "deranged", but the White House said Trump was warning of the risk of a nuclear Iran.

stories.title: Seven arrested for using Ghanaian banknotes to make 'money bouquets'
stories.body: The arrests are part of the country's efforts to curb the misuse and abuse of the national currency.

stories.title: US televangelist Jim Bakker, disgraced from sex scandal and fraud, dies at 86
stories.body: Jim Bakker co-founded The PTL Club with his then-wife Tammy Faye before being jailed for fraud and conspiracy.

stories.title: Yemeni military says it has 'secured' Red Sea waterway
stories.body: Saudi-backed forces gave conflicting reports of whether they had also seized the port city of Mokha, near the Bab al-Mandab Strait.

stories.title: Nigeria mourns 25 killed as military plane crashes into swamp
stories.body: President Bola Tinubu describes the crash as a "painful moment" for the military and the entire nation.

stories.title: Separatist party projected to win Quebec election, adding new test to Canada's unity
stories.body: The Parti Québécois, which secured a minority, has vowed to hold an independence referendum in the years to come.

stories.title: Fort Hood shooter to be executed by firing squad - a first for US military since World War Two
stories.body: Nidal Malik Hasan killed 13 unarmed soldiers and injured another 32 in the deadliest ever non-combat attack on an American military base.

stories.title: OpenAI admits response to Australian government hacks 'not good enough'
stories.body: Top executive Jason Kwon tells hearing company has added "more precautions" to its training environments.

stories.title: Samoa leader apologises for Nazi salute after video from 2007 emerges
stories.body: Schmidt acknowledged that his actions "were inappropriate and capable of causing offence and hurt".
